best_candidate_rationale: This is the most founder-accessible and cheapest-to-falsify remaining structure because the family installer can expose real handoffs and local collectors. It remains unqualified: the frequency of non-exempt handoffs, separate contractor willingness to pay, signed collector take-rate economics, low-touch support, and defensible separation from existing booking and BDO providers are all unproved.
binding_cross_candidate_limiters: Every candidate faced a native, incumbent, or close specialist substitute already bundling the proposed entry layer.
Observable mandatory spend or financial leakage did not establish willingness to pay a separate intermediary or software fee.
Buyer authority, data rights, submission rights, or a contracted distribution partner remained a decisive gate in every high-value structure.
Conservative unit economics and founder operating hours failed or depended on unobserved thresholds for frequency, value, margin, or low-touch delivery.
No bottom-up founder-net-worth path remained plausible without unvalidated scale, retention, margin, or valuation assumptions.
no_qualifier_reason: The single bounded research pass tested eight structurally varied candidates with 6-12 sources each; all eight were stopped because direct incumbents or native systems already cover the wedge and no candidate demonstrated a separately paid, founder-accessible control point with validated data/partner rights, conservative contribution economics, repeatable low-touch distribution, and a plausible bottom-up founder-net-worth path.
reopen_policy: Reopen only the named candidate-specific no-build test preserved in its research packet; do not add a new generation, research, or redesign loop to this run.

stop_candidates.highest_value_next_test: Do not build a monitoring product. From the EIPA registry, identify 20 legal operators that can be independently verified as having 20-500 connectors and request a contract-gap interview with the operations and budget owner. Require documentary disclosure of current CPMS, OEM warranty, installer maintenance, hotline, field-service spend, exclusions, CSMS admin rights, and 12 months of ticket outcomes. The idea is revived only if at least three buyers confirm an unfunded recurring gap and one prepays a 90-day, 50-connector pilot at no less than PLN 6,000/month while granting production access and accepting field labor, travel, parts, OEM escalation, UDT fees, and after-hours coverage as separately priced. Otherwise stop permanently.
stop_candidates.primary_limiter: No evidence establishes a separately purchasable uptime/SLA budget or transferable backend, remote-action, warranty, and repair rights, while Polish competitors already sell the exact 24/7 vendor-neutral or bundled service and the necessary field/on-call layer is incompatible with a part-time founder launch.
stop_candidates.stop_reason: The public data wedge is real but non-diagnostic and does not prove paid behavior. Direct Polish substitutes already provide 24/7 vendor-neutral or end-to-end operations, OEMs control warranty-grade diagnostics and certified repair, software remote control is inexpensive, and the unpriced technician/parts/on-call burden prevents credible part-time or software-like economics. The conditional wealth path needs roughly 4,700 connectors, about 40% of Poland's entire end-2025 public base, without evidence of the required displacement or CEE channel.

stop_candidates.highest_value_next_test: Reopen only through a six-week, no-build concierge test: instrument 30 consecutive handoffs at the family installer plus four unrelated contractors, recording contract allocation, code, annual-threshold status, whether KPO was required, who prepared it, staff minutes, quotes, slots, estimated and scale mass, correction, rejection, contamination, surcharge, empty run and support minutes. Ask all four unrelated contractors to pay 99 PLN for the next month, and ask two licensed collectors to sign terms exposing binding quotes/slots and scale tickets and paying 4% capped at 75 PLN only on new completed bookings. Reopen the candidate only if at least 20 of 30 handoffs require KPO, each unrelated contractor averages at least one such handoff per month, at least three of four contractors pay, both collectors sign, median avoidable value is at least 100 PLN or 20 staff minutes per account per month, and human support is at most ten minutes per completed pickup with at least 60% contribution margin.
stop_candidates.primary_limiter: No evidence establishes a scalable, reachable cohort of contractors with at least one non-exempt handoff per month and a separate budget after collector, free-BDO, low-cost software and outsourced-administration substitutes; without that density, the collector take rate and recurring contribution economics collapse.
stop_candidates.stop_reason: Stop the two-sided product in its current form: direct evidence proves regulation, paid pickups and isolated reconciliation pain, but also broad low-volume exemptions and close incumbents, while the decisive target frequency, separate software budget, collector margin, low-touch operating burden and data-reuse rights remain unevidenced. A tightly gated paid concierge test can reopen it without committing product capital.

stop_candidates.highest_value_next_test: Before building software or a network, run a 45-day evidence-and-paid-pilot test in one region. Obtain de-identified 12-month calendars, last protocols and invoices for at least 300 buildings from three unrelated private managers; present every manager the same binding terms of PLN 600 net per building-year plus a disclosed 15% dispatch/QA fee, inspector paid directly, and no c-KOB API promise; and route 30-50 actually due scopes through at least three insured qualified providers. Advance only if at least two managers totaling at least 150 buildings sign and pay those full terms, a measured time study or invoice comparison shows at least PLN 657 of annual buyer value per building, first-pass packet completeness is at least 95%, rework is at most 5%, every c-KOB evidence packet is ready within seven days, steady coordination/QA is at most two hours per building-year, contribution margin after rework/insurance is at least 40%, and modeled acquisition payback is no more than 12 months. Otherwise keep stopped.
stop_candidates.primary_limiter: Unproven capture of a separate recurring per-building fee: the documented core inspection prices leave only about PLN 57 per building-year at a 15% dispatch margin, which cannot fund the multi-specialty coordination, QA, rework and liability load.
stop_candidates.stop_reason: Mandatory inspections and one dense private procurement route are real, but they do not prove demand for a new intermediary. Free c-KOB and exact software/full-service incumbents cover much of the offer; the evidenced dispatch pool is too small on its own; authority, c-KOB integration, inspector capacity, QA liability, data rights and scalable buyer access remain unverified; and the operating load conflicts with the founder's part-time constraint.

stop_candidates.highest_value_next_test: Do not build software or fund site work. Reopen only after a blinded, pre-registered cohort: obtain twelve months of unselected invoices for 100 PPEs from at least 30 unrelated firms through the family installer plus three independent accountants/electricians; record the share with at least 24,000 PLN conservatively recoverable annual value, identify authorized signers, and ask every qualifying firm to sign the same agreement—customer-paid 2,400 PLN measurement and 900 PLN verification pass-through, 20% of normalized first-year savings, hardware separate. Stop permanently unless at least 10 firms qualify, at least 5 authorized buyers sign, and partner-attributed all-in acquisition plus founder/analyst labor stays below 30% of expected collected success fees. These are proposed falsification thresholds, not observed market facts.
stop_candidates.primary_limiter: The commercial wedge is already commoditized and bundled: named competitors provide the same invoice audit free and automated, outcome-linked full-stack remediation already exists, and TAURON sells through established partners. Without an independently measured prevalence of at least 24,000–30,000 PLN annual recoverable value among partner-reachable sites, the success-fee model cannot cover metering, acquisition and analysis while producing the throughput needed for a 5 million PLN founder-net-worth path.
stop_candidates.stop_reason: Stop at research: evidence confirms a real charge but not a defensible or sufficiently frequent paid opportunity. Exact free and outcome-linked competitors invalidate the proposed differentiation, modest documented sites fail provider-funded contingency economics, recurring revenue is unproven, and the conditional wealth path requires unvalidated high-value prevalence and 500 paid sites per year.

stop_candidates.highest_value_next_test: Do not build. Obtain owner authorization and audit 20 actually curtailed PV/wind assets from at least five unrelated owners and three DSOs, including firm/non-firm and PPA/support variants. For each, freeze the native WOZE entitlement, submission, settlement and cash baseline; have independent energy counsel validate any alternative; file only defensible gaps. Require within six months at least three paid incremental recoveries, at least PLN 250,000 aggregate incremental cash, median paid gap of at least PLN 160,000 among successful cases, three signed owner agreements at a technical fee no higher than 3% plus separately disclosed legal cost, and a repeat qualifying event in at least half of owners. Stop permanently if any threshold fails.
stop_candidates.primary_limiter: No evidence establishes a material, independently reachable pool of incremental under-recovery after PSE's native WOZE calculation, professional asset management and existing claims vendors; without that denominator, curtailed MWh cannot support the fee or founder-wealth case.
stop_candidates.stop_reason: The exact offer is already present at a 5% success-fee anchor, the operator itself automates the standard workflow, and neither official data nor competitor evidence shows paid incremental recovery. Conservative outcome-only economics require an unsupported scale of roughly 1,235 active under-recovered owners to reach PLN 5m of founder equity.

stop_candidates.highest_value_next_test: Only reopen after a pre-registered, paid, accountant-recruited 12-week randomized pilot across 10-15 Polish SMEs and at least 5,000 eligible invoices. Stratify by client, invoice value and days overdue; control must be the client's existing disciplined reminder sequence, not no action; treatment is the human-approved proposed sequence. Reconcile accounting and bank evidence, exclude disputes, credit notes, factoring and pre-existing promises, and measure cash by day 14/30, DSO, 60-day ultimate recovery, staff minutes, complaints and lost accounts. Require either at least a five-percentage-point and 20% relative lift in 30-day cash or a five-day DSO reduction, no reduction in 60-day recovery, no more than 1% attributable complaints, less than 0.5 human hour per client per month, at least 8 of 10 eligible firms signing at PLN 299 plus 3% of experimentally measured incremental cash, and partner-led acquisition cost below PLN 700. Otherwise keep the stop decision.
stop_candidates.primary_limiter: No evidence shows causally incremental recovery or DSO improvement, a separately authorized budget, and low-touch delivery beyond already available ERP dunning, Polish online collection and factoring; KSeF improves invoice access but not reliable live payment status or defensibility.
stop_candidates.stop_reason: The problem is real, but the proposed product is not yet a distinct or defensible business: core detection needs data outside KSeF, direct substitutes already sell automated dunning and recovery, bank and data rights add operational constraints, and the wealth path depends on unproven causal lift, attribution, channel conversion and retention.

stop_candidates.highest_value_next_test: Revive only through a no-build 30-day data-room test. Use the 37 Polish Shopify partners plus targeted CEE payments leads to ask 10 multi-PSP travel or digital merchants for 12 months of minimized dispute exports and time logs. Require at least 5 data donors and at least 3 merchants that each show 50 or more defendable disputes per month, at least 500 PLN average disputed value, and either material evidence missing from at least 20% of native packets or more than 10 staff minutes per case; each must sign a conditional LOI for a 20% recovered-principal fee. Blind-backtest 100 cases and prospectively review 50 merchant-approved cases, requiring at least 10 percentage points of win-rate lift or at least 8 labor minutes saved per case without deadline misses and at least 60% modeled mature gross margin. If any gate fails, keep the candidate stopped.
stop_candidates.primary_limiter: No evidence-backed CEE buyer wedge meets the dispute-volume, average-value, evidence-gap, and incremental-lift conditions required for reviewed outcome-only unit economics in a market already served by processor-native and cross-processor automation.
stop_candidates.stop_reason: Category pain and paid behavior are real, but global losses do not prove CEE willingness to pay this layer. Current evidence shows strong native and incumbent substitution, modest dispute values, slow payouts, processor-specific permissions, privacy constraints, and no sourced accessible merchant population or incremental lift; the conservative founder wealth path depends on multiple unvalidated thresholds.

stop_candidates.highest_value_next_test: Before any build, obtain a written Polish occupational-law opinion approving the exact controller, processor, agency and clinic-contract structure; then run a 30-day paid concierge with three KRAZ-listed staffing agencies that each document at least 500 annual Art. 229 exams and five registered basic units. Require signed live-inventory and pricing terms, 200 completed exams, either a PLN 30 separate employer fee or at least PLN 30 signed clinic share, at least 70% contribution after no-shows and support, median appointment within 48 hours and at least 20% faster than the incumbent route, at least one employer admin hour saved per 50 exams, and two agency reorders. Stop immediately if the legal route fails or fewer than two agencies pay and reorder.
stop_candidates.primary_limiter: There is no evidence that employers or clinics will fund an incremental PLN 25-40 per completed exam for a workflow already bundled by medical networks and payroll systems, while the statutory employer-basic-unit contract materially restricts the open inventory-routing premise.
stop_candidates.stop_reason: Stop at research stage: mandatory exam volume and reachable buyers are proven, but incremental paid behavior, clinic margin, compliant cross-unit routing, data reuse, founder-compatible operations and an advantage over directly substitutable incumbent products are not.
